scope: Primary-source audit of the public ActionMesh generation path needed to reproduce the current official non-fast ActionMesh row over all 128 ActionBench objects. This audit did not run inference, scoring, tests, or a GPU workload.

tree_search.finding: The complete public tree contains a single-sample video-to-mesh entrypoint and the dataset evaluator, but no ActionBench batch-generation driver, leaderboard prediction bundle, or manifest tying generated meshes to the published row.

currently_available_model_revisions.role: background-removal model loaded before alpha-mask validation

download_reproducibility_finding.source_behavior: ActionMesh calls huggingface_hub.snapshot_download(repo_id=..., local_dir=...) for all four model repositories without a revision argument and reuses any nonempty local directory without verifying its revision or file closure.
download_reproducibility_finding.implication: A fresh execution against moving main branches and a reused nonempty cache can resolve to different or incomplete bytes. The four currently available revisions above are pin candidates, not proof of the revisions used for the published leaderboard row.
download_reproducibility_finding.required_repair_before_dispatch: Pre-stage complete snapshots at explicit immutable revisions, retain the Hub download manifests and local file hashes, reject partial/nonmatching directories, and run ActionMesh offline against those verified paths.

not_published_for_the_leaderboard_row: exact revisions and file hashes of all four downloaded model repositories
TripoSG submodule revision used by the leaderboard run
Python, PyTorch, torchvision, CUDA and remaining dependency versions
retry, interruption, failure and exclusion policy
complete prediction manifest and per-output hashes
published_generation_identity.adjudication: The current public release is sufficient to construct a new explicitly versioned reproduction attempt, but is not source evidence that the attempt exactly matches the unpublished leaderboard generation environment. Report that scope as current-public-release reproduction, not exact published-run replay.

single_2080ti_admission.official_documentation: The current ActionMesh README states 32 GB VRAM for default mode and 12 GB with --low_ram; it does not document an RTX 2080 Ti result.
single_2080ti_admission.adjudication: Do not assume the target row fits or is numerically identical on the user's card. Local must first capture actual device memory and then measure one complete non-fast, seed-42, 16-frame generation plus its export and official scoring path. OOM is an observed natural failure, not permission to silently switch variant, dtype, configuration, population, or metric.

dispatch_admission.reason: The public source chain is now identified, but published-run generation provenance, immutable local snapshots, complete GT/prediction manifests, current runtime/device qualification, and measured complete-unit time/VRAM remain absent.
